headline: J&J Prostate Cancer Drug Shows Promising Tumor Reduction in Early-Stage Trial
summary: Johnson & Johnson reported that its investigational prostate cancer drug demonstrated promising tumor shrinkage in an early-stage clinical trial.
why: Johnson & Johnson is a leading global healthcare and pharmaceutical company; oncology pipeline developments are key long-term revenue drivers.

impacts.name: Johnson & Johnson
impacts.why: Positive early clinical results de-risk pipeline assets and support future commercial oncology prospects.
